# ============================================================================
# m3tetmesh — Mould3r's wrapper DLL around fTetWild (see m3tetmesh.h).
#
# fTetWild is pulled at a PINNED commit and built as a subproject, so its
# command-line tool, tests and the AGPL TetGen module are never built. Its
# other dependencies (libigl, Geogram, spdlog, fmt, oneTBB, json) come in
# through fTetWild's own FetchContent at the versions it pins; GMP's rationals
# come from mini-gmp (below).
# Everything is linked STATICALLY into m3tetmesh, so the DLL is all that ships.
#
# Windows: run build_windows.bat. Linux (development / testing):
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build --target m3tetmesh
# ============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)   # FetchContent EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
project(m3tetmesh CXX C)

set(M3_FTETWILD_COMMIT "8118f810478e0e65a7bf2d8cecdc5e203a876e97" CACHE STRING "fTetWild commit to build")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)          # dependencies static, only m3tetmesh is a DLL
if(MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>DLL")   # /MD, same CRT as Mould3r
    add_compile_options(/bigobj /EHsc /utf-8)
endif()

# Keep copyleft / unused libigl modules off (TetGen is AGPL).
set(LIBIGL_COPYLEFT_TETGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_COPYLEFT_CGAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_COPYLEFT_COMISO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_RESTRICTED_TRIANGLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_WITH_TETGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_GLFW OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_OPENGL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_IMGUI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_EMBREE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_PNG OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_XML OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBIGL_BUILD_TUTORIALS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLOAT_TETWILD_ENABLE_TBB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLOAT_TETWILD_WITH_EXACT_ENVELOPE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# GMP: fTetWild only needs GMP's exact rationals (mpq_* in its Rational.h).
# By default those come from mini-gmp - GMP's own small, portable C subset,
# shipped in the official GMP release - compiled straight into m3tetmesh. That
# avoids building full GMP on Windows (vcpkg does that through MSYS2, whose
# package pins go stale) and there is no GMP DLL to ship. Same licence as GMP
# (LGPL-3.0-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later). Set M3_USE_MINI_GMP=OFF and pass
# GMP_INCLUDE_DIRS / GMP_LIBRARIES to use a full GMP instead.
option(M3_USE_MINI_GMP "Use GMP's mini-gmp (compiled in) instead of a full GMP" ON)
set(M3_MINI_GMP_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Folder holding mini-gmp.c/.h and mini-mpq.c/.h (empty = download GMP 6.3.0)")
if(M3_USE_MINI_GMP)
    if(M3_MINI_GMP_DIR STREQUAL "")
        include(FetchContent)
        # The official GMP 6.3.0 release, checked against the same SHA-512
        # vcpkg's gmp port uses.
        FetchContent_Declare(gmpsrc
            URL https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gmp/gmp-6.3.0.tar.xz
                https://ftpmirror.gnu.org/gmp/gmp-6.3.0.tar.xz
                https://gmplib.org/download/gmp/gmp-6.3.0.tar.xz
            URL_HASH SHA512=e85a0dab5195889948a3462189f0e0598d331d3457612e2d3350799dba2e244316d256f8161df5219538eb003e4b5343f989aaa00f96321559063ed8c8f29fd2
            DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE)
        FetchContent_MakeAvailable(gmpsrc)   # no CMakeLists in GMP: this only unpacks it
        set(M3_MINI_GMP_DIR "${gmpsrc_SOURCE_DIR}/mini-gmp")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}/mini-mpq.c")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "mini-gmp not found in '${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}'")
    endif()
    # One translation unit, mini-gmp.c then mini-mpq.c: mini-mpq relies on
    # macros / helpers mini-gmp.c defines (as GMP's own mini-gmp tests build it).
    set(M3_MINI_GMP_TU "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/m3_minigmp.c")
    file(WRITE "${M3_MINI_GMP_TU}"
         "/* Generated by m3tetmesh: mini-gmp + its rational extension, one unit. */\n"
         "#include \"${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}/mini-gmp.c\"\n"
         "#include \"${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}/mini-mpq.c\"\n")
    add_library(m3_minigmp STATIC "${M3_MINI_GMP_TU}")
    target_include_directories(m3_minigmp PUBLIC "${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}")
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(m3_minigmp PRIVATE /wd4146 /wd4244 /wd4267)   # unsigned negation etc., by design
    endif()
    # fTetWild does #include <gmp.h>: a one-line stand-in that pulls in mini-gmp's rationals.
    set(M3_GMP_SHIM_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gmp_shim")
    file(WRITE "${M3_GMP_SHIM_DIR}/gmp.h"
         "/* Generated by m3tetmesh: mini-gmp stands in for GMP (see CMakeLists.txt). */\n"
         "#pragma once\n#include \"${M3_MINI_GMP_DIR}/mini-mpq.h\"\n")
    set(GMP_INCLUDE_DIRS "${M3_GMP_SHIM_DIR}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
    set(GMP_LIBRARIES m3_minigmp CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# Eigen: by default libigl fetches the version it pins (3.4.0), the one fTetWild
# is tested with. Nothing Eigen crosses the DLL's C interface, so it needn't
# match Mould3r's own Eigen (vcpkg ships 5.x). M3_USE_CALLER_EIGEN=ON uses an
# Eigen found by find_package instead (e.g. when GitLab can't be reached);
# libigl's recipe skips its download when Eigen3::Eigen already exists.
option(M3_USE_CALLER_EIGEN "Use find_package(Eigen3) instead of libigl's pinned Eigen 3.4.0" OFF)
if(M3_USE_CALLER_EIGEN)
    find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
endif()

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(ftetwild
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/wildmeshing/fTetWild.git
    GIT_TAG        ${M3_FTETWILD_COMMIT}
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)            # only what m3tetmesh links gets built
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ftetwild)

# MSVC 14.5x (VS 2026) no longer ships the old <hash_map> header, which
# Geogram's bundled PoissonRecon still includes on MSVC (fTetWild never uses
# PoissonRecon, but Geogram builds it). Give that one target a stand-in that
# maps stdext::hash_map onto std::unordered_map - no downloaded source is
# patched. Harmless on older MSVC (the stand-in is found first either way).
if(MSVC AND TARGET geogram_third_party)
    set(M3_HASH_MAP_SHIM_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/msvc_hash_map_shim")
    file(WRITE "${M3_HASH_MAP_SHIM_DIR}/hash_map"
         "// Generated by m3tetmesh: stand-in for MSVC's removed <hash_map> (see CMakeLists.txt).\n"
         "#pragma once\n"
         "#include <functional>\n#include <memory>\n#include <unordered_map>\n"
         "namespace stdext {\n"
         "template <class K, class T, class H = std::hash<K>, class E = std::equal_to<K>,\n"
         "          class A = std::allocator<std::pair<const K, T>>>\n"
         "using hash_map = std::unordered_map<K, T, H, E, A>;\n"
         "}\n")
    target_include_directories(geogram_third_party BEFORE PRIVATE "${M3_HASH_MAP_SHIM_DIR}")
endif()

add_library(m3tetmesh SHARED m3tetmesh.cpp m3tetmesh.h)
target_compile_definitions(m3tetmesh PRIVATE M3TETMESH_BUILD)
target_link_libraries(m3tetmesh PRIVATE FloatTetwild)
set_target_properties(m3tetmesh PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
if(NOT MSVC)
    # Keep the static dependencies' symbols private (MSVC exports only
    # __declspec(dllexport) anyway).
    target_link_options(m3tetmesh PRIVATE "LINKER:--exclude-libs,ALL")
endif()
# No install() rules: build_windows.bat copies the DLL, import library and
# header into out\ (installing would also run the dependencies' own rules).
